gloss: unpleasant smell; fishy or gamey odor

definitions.gloss: unpleasant smell; fishy or gamey odor
definitions.explanation: An unpleasant smell, especially the fishy or gamey smell of fish and meat that cooking tries to remove. Also, figuratively, an affected or off-putting quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{臭|くさ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
examples.english: Adding ginger gets rid of the odor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}→牛乳：00777_gyuunyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漬|つ}けて→漬ける：09861_tsukeru⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{臭|くさ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けて→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかく→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you soak the meat in milk, the gamey smell goes away and it becomes tender.

notes:
The -み noun from ⟦{臭|くさ}い→臭い：01133_kusai⟧. Mostly a cooking word: recipes tell you how to take the {臭|くさ}み out of fish, meat, or vegetables.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {臭|くさ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ / ⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to remove the smell
- {臭|くさ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧: the smell goes away
- {臭|くさ}み{取|と}り: removing odors (in recipes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧: smell (neutral or pleasant)
- {臭|にお}い: smell (unpleasant)
- {生臭|なまぐさ}さ: fishy, raw smell
